notes: Fictional content; base is replaced by the local site address. split=dev may be used to debug the harness and prompts; split=test must not be run until the configuration is frozen. The jotter site appears only in the test split.
selection: Tasks cover the six gate-study categories plus form submission and unsatisfiable requests, at tiers 1 (one action), 2 (two or three), 3 (four to six) and 4 (more). Excluded by design: tasks needing an account, payment, a CAPTCHA, the live web, or an outcome that neither the server state nor the answer text can check.
